text:
mira (Marketing): we need a tight benchmark narrative for the webinar. goal: show how teams trade latency vs $/1M tokens and how routing + caching changes the math. want 2 visuals + 1 headline. ideas?

reza (Analytics): propose: (1) line chart: cost per 1M tokens vs QPS for 3 variants, (2) violin/boxplot of latency distribution at target QPS. highlights: tail behavior, cost slope as QPS grows.

jonah (Engineering): include variants: hosted-standard, dedicated-2xA100, private-qlora-cpu. measure at 100qps and 1000qps. note where KV cache hits reduce effective QPS.

ellen (Growth): headline should be customer-facing: "Optimize for experience and economics: predictable latency, transparent cost." one-liner under headline: "Choose the deployment profile that matches your SLO and traffic shape."

tess (Content): short bullets for the slide: 1) "Hit interactive SLOs (p95 < 150ms) with dedicated pools for steady traffic." 2) "Reduce tokens cost by up to 60% for bursty workloads using KV caching and model routing."

reza (Analytics): sample CSV outputs I'll produce for plotting:
```
variant,qps,p95_ms,cost_usd_per_1M
hosted,100,160,50
hosted,1000,260,52
dedicated,100,140,32
dedicated,1000,170,35
private-qlora,100,420,10
private-qlora,1000,480,12
```

and latency distribution sample for violin plot (p50,p75,p95,p99):
```
variant,p50,p75,p95,p99
hosted,80,120,160,300
dedicated,70,100,140,220
private-qlora,120,250,420,720
```

jonah (Engineering): add micro-note: "measurements on 8k context, steady-slow ramp; batching enabled for cost lines, disabled for p95 numbers (we'll call this out)."

mira (Marketing): good. reza, can you also compute a "routing savings" scenario: start 80% traffic to hosted then fallback to dedicated when latency > 250ms; compute blended $/1M token. we can show that as a small table.

reza (Analytics): will do. ops-bot: kick off bench #901 to capture these points.

ops-bot: benchmark-run #901 queued by reza 3: collecting latency traces and cost traces. https://bench.redwood/901

tess (Content): also want a 1-sentence teaser for the webinar landing page: "See real workload benchmarks: how to choose the right inference profile to meet latency SLAs while optimizing token economics."

ellen (Growth): add CTA note: "signup link + quick cost estimator" on the landing page. keeps the funnel tight.

reza (Analytics): uploaded preliminary CSV to drive: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/bench-1764123456.csv. preliminary numbers: hosted p95@100qps=160ms cost 50, dedicated p95@100qps=140ms cost 32, qlora p95@100qps=420ms cost 10.

mira (Marketing): those are great. final asks: tess will refine headline + bullets, reza to finalize CSV with routing scenario, jonah to add the footnote about quantization variance. deadline: EOD tomorrow for deck insertion. thanks all :tada:
